items.name: The Magnolia House
items.description: A two-story custom build with four and a half baths, a basement bar, and a tankless water heater. We ran underground before the slab, roughed in after framing, and set every fixture at trim.

photos.caption: Supply and drain lines roughed in through the second-floor framing
Underground drain, waste, and vent set and inspected before the slab pour
Master bath trim-out with the fixtures set and tested
Tankless water heater and softener hookup in the mechanical room

items.name: 2023 Westminster
items.description: A full re-plumb during a whole-house remodel, with the kitchen moved to the back of the house and two new baths. New supply throughout, new drains where the layout changed, and fixtures set on the builder's schedule.

photos.caption: Kitchen sink and dishwasher lines relocated to the new island
New toilets and faucets set in both upstairs baths
Whole-house softener plumbed in at the main

items.name: The Hawthorne Build
items.description: A three-bath two-story spec home, underground through trim. We priced it off the plans, met every inspection, and had trim done a day ahead of the builder's walkthrough.

photos.caption: Final fixture set in the primary bath
Gas runs to the range, fireplace, and water heater, pressure tested
Takeoff from the builder's plans before the bid

items.name: 118 Prairie Ridge
items.description: New construction on a walkout lot with a sewer tie-in at the street and a sump system in the lower level. Underground and rough-in on a tight framing schedule.

photos.caption: Underground set to the plan and ready for the inspector
Water service and sewer lateral tied in at the street
Rough-in through the main floor framing

items.name: The Clearwater Residence
items.description: A finished basement with a full bath and wet bar. New drain lines cut into the slab, a sump and ejector pit, and a gas line for the fireplace.

photos.caption: Drain lines cut in and tied to the main under the slab
Sump and ejector pit set in the lower level
Gas line run to the new fireplace
